story.title: Packaging experts since 2010
story.p1: Harmac Oy began in 2010 with a simple idea: buying a packaging machine shouldn't be guesswork. We operate in Vantaa, in the Tikkurilan Simonkylä area, and we know packaging machinery inside out.
story.p2: We've imported packaging machines from leading European manufacturers and put them into production at dozens of companies — from small artisan bakeries to large food factories.
story.p3: We don't sell whatever is easiest for us. We listen to your production needs first and recommend a solution that will still serve you years from now.
